manifest.protocol: Paired random cases for all three controllers. Transfer groups excluded from controller development; electrical integration smoke checks were performed before this benchmark. This is not a blind external holdout. No model fitting or parameter tuning.
limitations: Signature diversity counts observed constraint/element/action combinations, not distinct defects.
Temporal fixture tests one intentionally seeded state-machine defect; repeated seeds do not create new mechanisms.
Actual-demand reference is privileged and only labels attainability; it is not a competing equally informed controller.
Finite uncertainty samples, two small networks and two fault positions each cannot establish operational safety or field generalization.
The supplied paired search results are analyzed without treating their reanalysis as an independent discovery experiment.

reference.title: Marcelo de Castro Fernandes, 2018 thesis, Table 13, Official Results column
reference.note: Independently published IEEE reference values, transcribed by phase. The RPI table calls the regulator output 650; excluded to avoid bus-name ambiguity.
